bounded_conclusions: Within one prepared solve, MODERATE nonlinear under-relaxation history causes the DSW-09 head stall when the external coupler changes the affine tangent between outer iterations.

After disabling that nonlinear-history mechanism, a distinct inner residual certification floor remains: 1e-15 and 1e-14 do not certify, while 1e-13 and 1e-12 certify the same already reached physical root.
The original DSW-09 physics gate is not relaxed; this diagnostic only separates MODFLOW solver-state behavior from the external nonlinear residual.
These oracle values do not define a production IMS tolerance.
